items.t: Why Is BlackRock (BLK) Up 8.6% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.sum: BlackRock (BLK) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.t: New Retirement in America Podcast Explores How BlackRock Is Bringing Pension-Like Benefits to 401(k) Plans

items.t: Barclays, Citi increase stakes in iconic BlackRock fund
items.sum: Barclays and Citigroup boost stake in BlackRock’s IBIT.

items.t: Here’s How Much You Would Have Made Owning BlackRock Stock In The Last 20 Years
items.sum: BlackRock (NYSE:BLK) has outperformed the market over the past 20 years by 2.29% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 11.07%. Currently, BlackRock has a market capitalization of $189.37 billion.

items.t: Securitize and Ethena Open 24/7 BlackRock BUIDL Liquidity Facility With $50 Million Funded
items.sum: The pool opens with $50 million for weekend and after-hours swaps between BUIDL and USDC, and a matching $50 million can be added within an hour.
